headline: ARI @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.44 at CIN 4.65, with a projected total of 9.09. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: ARI moved +0.10 runs while CIN moved +0.60, changing the projected margin by -0.50 runs. The projected total climbed +0.71, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Blake Dunn, JJ Bleday, Geraldo Perdomo, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Pavin Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
